title: Config Restart — payload
description: Request a graceful restart so a process supervisor brings the maintainer back up with restart-gated configuration applied. Takes no parameters.

supervisor.description: The process supervisor that will bring the maintainer back up, detected by the maintainer. An opaque maintainer-defined label — the framework does not enumerate it (e.g. `systemd`, `kubernetes`, or an explicit operator opt-in). A maintainer that detects no supervisor MUST refuse (see errorCodes) rather than exit unsupervised.

drainTimeoutSeconds.description: How long the maintainer will drain in-flight work before exiting, so a caller knows the expected downtime window.
